verdict: It's a tie. Both are about ~200 kcal a glass, with almost the same protein and fat. What matters is how often and how sweet you order it.
why: Neslo ais and Milo ais are both about ~200 kcal a glass.
Protein is almost the same too: Neslo 4 g, Milo 5 g. A 1 g difference doesn't make a big difference to fullness.
Fat is the same, 5 g each, mostly from condensed milk or creamer.
Both are tasty and sweet, and easily become your 'must-have drink' every time you go to the mamak. That's where calories add up without you noticing.
when_a: Neslo ais is okay when you need a bit of caffeine for a long afternoon at the office.
when_b: Milo ais is okay as a drink after exercise or when you lepak with family on the weekend.
tip: Order 'kurang manis' (less sweet) and keep these sweet drinks to 2-3 times a week only. On other days, choose teh O ais limau kosong (iced lime tea, no sugar) or plain water.

faq.q: Is Milo ais okay after the gym?
faq.a: It's okay if it fits into your daily calories. Just remember, 5 g of protein is quite little. Make sure your next meal has enough protein.

faq.q: If I order 'kosong' (no sugar), are there still calories?
faq.a: There are still some from the powder and milk, but much lower than the usual version made with sweetened condensed milk.
